given: The prospective customer is not yet registered and has no in-flight KYC application of the same identity.
when: The Customer performs customer registration with aadhaar and pan with valid inputs and permissions.
then: A registration record is created and a KYC application (Aadhaar + PAN) is submitted for review.

given: The prospective customer is not yet registered and has no in-flight KYC application of the same identity.
when: Attempt customer registration with aadhaar and pan using the condition that produces INVALID_AADHAAR_FORMAT.
then: The Aadhaar number you entered is not in the expected 12-digit format. Please check the value and try again.

given: The prospective customer has entered Aadhaar and PAN values during registration.
when: The Customer performs aadhaar and pan format validation with valid inputs and permissions.
then: Malformed values are rejected and the malformed field is reported; well-formed values are accepted for KYC submission.

given: The prospective customer has entered Aadhaar and PAN values during registration.
when: Attempt aadhaar and pan format validation using the condition that produces INVALID_AADHAAR_FORMAT.
then: The Aadhaar number you entered is not in the expected 12-digit format. Please check the value and try again.

given: A KYC application has passed format validation and is in a submitted state.
when: The Bank operations performs route kyc application to bank operations review with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The KYC application is visible to Bank operations in a pending-review state.

given: A KYC application has passed format validation and is in a submitted state.
when: Attempt route kyc application to bank operations review with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
then: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

given: The KYC application is in the pending-review state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
when: The Bank operations performs approve or reject a kyc application with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The KYC application reaches an approved or rejected state; approval enables account creation in step FR-005.

given: The KYC application is in the pending-review state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
when: Attempt approve or reject a kyc application using the condition that produces KYC_NOT_APPROVED.
then: Your identity (KYC) has not been approved yet, so this action is not available. Please wait for your KYC review to be completed.

given: A KYC application associated with the customer has been approved.
when: The Customer performs create pending account on kyc approval with valid inputs and permissions.
then: An account record is created in the pending state, not yet usable for transactions.

given: A KYC application associated with the customer has been approved.
when: Attempt create pending account on kyc approval with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
then: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

given: The account is in the pending state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
when: The Bank operations performs activate a pending account with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The account transitions to the active state and becomes usable for transactions.

given: The account is in the pending state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
when: Attempt activate a pending account using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
then: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

given: The account is in the active state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
when: The Bank operations performs freeze an active account with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The account transitions to the frozen state; it no longer permits outgoing transfers.

given: The account is in the active state and the actor holds the Bank operations role.
when: Attempt freeze an active account using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
then: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

given: The user holds a valid identity and credentials for the Customer or Bank operations role.
when: The Customer performs login with valid credentials with valid inputs and permissions.
then: An authenticated session is established for the user.

given: The user holds a valid identity and credentials for the Customer or Bank operations role.
when: Attempt login with valid credentials using the condition that produces AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.
then: Your username or password is incorrect. Please check your credentials and try again.

given: A user submits a login attempt with invalid credentials.
when: The Customer performs reject login with invalid credentials with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The login attempt is rejected and no session is established.

given: A user submits a login attempt with invalid credentials.
when: Attempt reject login with invalid credentials using the condition that produces AUTHENTICATION_FAILED.
then: Your username or password is incorrect. Please check your credentials and try again.

given: The user holds an authenticated session.
when: The Customer performs logout and terminate session with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The session is terminated and protected functionality is no longer accessible.

given: The user holds an authenticated session.
when: Attempt logout and terminate session using the condition that produces SESSION_EXPIRED.
then: Your session has ended, either because you logged out or because it expired. Please log in again to continue.

given: The Customer is authenticated, holds an active account, and specifies a transfer amount and a recipient account.
when: The Customer performs customer initiates a transfer with valid inputs and permissions.
then: A transfer is processed that debits the sender balance and credits the recipient balance, and a transaction is recorded.

given: The Customer is authenticated, holds an active account, and specifies a transfer amount and a recipient account.
when: Attempt customer initiates a transfer using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
then: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

given: A Bank operations user attempts to initiate a money transfer.
when: The Bank operations performs prevent bank operations from initiating transfers with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The attempt is denied and no transfer is created.

given: A Bank operations user attempts to initiate a money transfer.
when: Attempt prevent bank operations from initiating transfers using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
then: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

given: A transfer initiated by a Customer passes all validation checks.
when: The Customer performs debit sender and credit recipient on success with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The sender's balance is reduced by the transfer amount and the recipient's balance is increased by the same amount.

given: A transfer initiated by a Customer passes all validation checks.
when: Attempt debit sender and credit recipient on success using the condition that produces INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE.
then: The transfer amount exceeds the available balance on your account. Please enter a smaller amount and try again.

given: A transfer has been successfully processed.
when: The Customer performs record a transaction for every transfer with valid inputs and permissions.
then: A transaction entry exists and is visible to both the sending and receiving Customer.

given: A transfer has been successfully processed.
when: Attempt record a transaction for every transfer with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
then: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

given: The user is authenticated and selects an account and a period they are permitted to view.
when: The Customer performs view an account statement with valid inputs and permissions.
then: A statement for the selected account and period is displayed.

given: The user is authenticated and selects an account and a period they are permitted to view.
when: Attempt view an account statement using the condition that produces ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND.
then: The account you are looking for could not be found. Please check the account details and try again.

given: The Customer is authenticated and selects their own account and a statement period.
when: The Customer performs download an account statement as a file with valid inputs and permissions.
then: A downloadable statement file is produced for the Customer.

given: The Customer is authenticated and selects their own account and a statement period.
when: Attempt download an account statement as a file using the condition that produces INVALID_STATEMENT_PERIOD.
then: The statement period you selected is not valid. Please choose a period with a start date before the end date.

given: The actor holds the Bank operations role and is authenticated.
when: The Bank operations performs audit-trail view of account and transaction state changes with valid inputs and permissions.
then: Bank operations can view the recorded state changes for accounts and transactions.

given: The actor holds the Bank operations role and is authenticated.
when: Attempt audit-trail view of account and transaction state changes using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
then: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

given: KYC or account data exists in the system.
when: The Customer performs baseline security controls with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The data remains protected through encryption in transit and role-based access control.

given: KYC or account data exists in the system.
when: Attempt baseline security controls using the condition that produces UNAUTHORIZED_ACTION.
then: You are not allowed to perform this action with your current access. Please contact support if you believe this is a mistake.

given: Aadhaar or PAN data is rendered in a UI display or written to a log.
when: The Customer performs mask customer pii outside kyc review with valid inputs and permissions.
then: PII is masked everywhere except authorized KYC review contexts.

given: Aadhaar or PAN data is rendered in a UI display or written to a log.
when: Attempt mask customer pii outside kyc review with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
then: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

given: A customer-facing screen is rendered.
when: The Customer performs baseline accessibility conformance with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The screen is keyboard-navigable and its form fields are labeled.

given: A customer-facing screen is rendered.
when: Attempt baseline accessibility conformance with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
then: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

given: A state-changing action on a KYC application, account, or transaction is performed.
when: The Customer performs log every state-changing action with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The action is logged with actor, timestamp, and before/after state.

given: A state-changing action on a KYC application, account, or transaction is performed.
when: Attempt log every state-changing action with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
then: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

given: An agent-generated artifact is produced at any pipeline stage.
when: The Bank operations performs schema-valid, source-linked artifacts with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The artifact is schema-valid and carries explicit source links.

given: An agent-generated artifact is produced at any pipeline stage.
when: Attempt schema-valid, source-linked artifacts with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
then: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

given: An in-scope customer journey is available in the system.
when: The Customer performs reliable and testable end-to-end journeys with valid inputs and permissions.
then: The journey can be exercised end-to-end by automated tests.

given: An in-scope customer journey is available in the system.
when: Attempt reliable and testable end-to-end journeys with an invalid, unauthorized, or incomplete input/state.
then: The action is rejected, no unintended state change occurs, and the user is told how to correct the condition.

given: An authenticated Customer uses the minimum_balance named placeholder; its value remains unresolved pending OQ-001.
when: The Customer submits a transfer with the result below the minimum_balance threshold.
then: This transfer would reduce the account balance below the required minimum. Please enter a smaller amount and try again.

given: An authenticated Customer uses the minimum_balance named placeholder; its value remains unresolved pending OQ-001.
when: The Customer submits a transfer with the result at the minimum_balance threshold.
then: The transfer is permitted: balance at exactly minimum balance -> transfer of zero net allowed, no further debit permitted.

given: An authenticated Customer uses the minimum_balance named placeholder; its value remains unresolved pending OQ-001.
when: The Customer submits a transfer with the result above the minimum_balance threshold.
then: The transfer is permitted: balance above minimum balance -> transfer permitted up to available balance.

given: An authenticated Customer uses the daily_transfer_cap named placeholder; its value remains unresolved pending OQ-002.
when: The Customer submits a transfer with the result below the daily_transfer_cap threshold.
then: The transfer is permitted: cumulative transfers below daily cap -> permitted.

given: An authenticated Customer uses the daily_transfer_cap named placeholder; its value remains unresolved pending OQ-002.
when: The Customer submits a transfer with the result at the daily_transfer_cap threshold.
then: The transfer is permitted: cumulative transfers at exactly daily cap -> permitted.

given: An authenticated Customer uses the daily_transfer_cap named placeholder; its value remains unresolved pending OQ-002.
when: The Customer submits a transfer with the result above the daily_transfer_cap threshold.
then: This transfer would exceed your daily transfer limit. Please try again later or contact support.
